@graph.name: YAML Config Validator Pro
@graph.description: Free online YAML validator, formatter, and converter with live syntax checking. Supports Kubernetes, Docker Compose, and GitHub Actions YAML files.
featureList: Live YAML syntax validation with line and column error reporting
YAML to JSON and JSON to YAML conversion

mainEntity.name: Is YAML Config Validator Pro free to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, YAML Config Validator Pro is completely free to use. All validation, formatting, and conversion features are available without registration or payment.

mainEntity.name: Does YAML Config Validator Pro support Kubernetes YAML files?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we have a dedicated Kubernetes YAML validator at /validator/kubernetes/ that validates Kubernetes manifests including Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and Pods with live syntax checking.

mainEntity.name: Can I convert YAML to JSON and back?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the Convert tab supports bidirectional conversion between YAML and JSON. You can switch between YAML to JSON and JSON to YAML modes instantly.

mainEntity.name: Is my YAML data stored on your servers?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. All validation and conversion happens entirely in your browser. Your YAML data never leaves your device or is stored on any server.
